attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

feast.note: Doxologia keeps him twice: its calendar prints him on 8 octombrie, the day of his martyrdom and of his father George's, and again on 1 mai — «Sfântul Nou Mucenic Ignatie», beside the two other new-martyrs of the Holy Mountain, Eftimie and Acachie, whose relics the same day page names at Mănăstirea Neamţ. One attestation row per church is the schema, so the row is his own day and the second day is recorded here. Both days serve the same life, doxologia.ro/viata-sfantului-nou-mucenic-ignatie, so there is nothing to tell the two apart; the «1 Mai» in his page's head is that second commemoration and not a style conversion. Read 25 September 2026.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pe 8 octombrie — «Sfântul Nou Mucenic Ignatie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Ιγνάτιος ο νέος Οσιομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: John of Zagora in the eparchy the page calls Τύρναβος, whose parents were George and Maria, who was tonsured Ignatius at the skete of the Forerunner on Athos, and who was hanged at Constantinople on 8 October 1814 at the sixth hour. The page states that date, so a `dates` object is proposed from its own words. **A second feast: the same page says «Ο Ιγνάτιος, μαζί με τους συνασκητές του μάρτυρες, Ευθύμιο και Ακάκιο, γιορτάζουν μαζί την 1η Μαΐου» — that Ignatius keeps 1 May together with his fellow ascetics the martyrs Euthymios and Akakios.** One attestation row per church is the schema, so that day is recorded here as a note and the row stays on 8 October, which is the day page that was read and quoted; the 1 May page was not fetched. The page prints no hymn for him. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (24 September 2026).
